activity_statements.statement: delivers next-generation digital transformation services to enterprise clients in 59 countries, including AI-first core IT modernization, cloud migration, and agile digital enablement at scale
manages the systems and workings of global enterprises through managed IT services, infrastructure services, and outsourced business processes across 40+ years of client relationships
provides business process outsourcing (BPO) through Infosys BPM, covering finance and accounting, procurement, customer service, HR, and document management
develops and delivers SaaS platforms through EdgeVerve Systems (banking/financial services) and Infosys McCamish (insurance BPO platform)
accelerates client IT transformation through transfer of digital skills, expertise, and ideas via its Infosys Knowledge Institute and innovation ecosystem
operates $20.3B in annual revenue with 328,000+ employees, ranked in the top 3 IT services brands globally for the fifth consecutive year (Brand Finance 2026)
maintains a global alliance network with major technology companies to reduce implementation risk and accelerate time-to-market for enterprise clients

name_reality_gap: Index label 'IT Services and IT Consulting' is accurate; the hidden reality is that Infosys is simultaneously a talent-at-scale body shop (largest job function), a managed-services operator for global enterprise infrastructure, and a SaaS product company (EdgeVerve, McCamish) — three structurally different businesses under one label.
extraction_notes: About page provided strong operational content. BPO subsidiaries (McCamish, EdgeVerve) are public knowledge from Infosys's disclosures but not detailed on the about page itself.
